headline: GPU rental prices held flat across all six tracked GPUs this week; MI300X leads on price-performance.
bullets: Every tracked GPU posted a +0% change over the 7-day window, with market indexes of $8.50 for B200, $5.40 for H200, $4.62 for H100 SXM and $2.70 for A100 80GB SXM.
MI300X offers the best price-performance at $3.62 per PFLOP-hour, just ahead of B200 at $3.78, while A100 80GB SXM is the costliest per unit of compute at $8.65.
Hyperscaler premiums are widest on H100 SXM at +140% ($10.68 vs $4.45 neocloud) and MI300X at +131%, and narrowest on B200 at +77%.
RunPod Community Cloud is the cheapest provider for B200 ($5.98), H200 ($3.59), H100 SXM ($2.69) and L40S ($0.79), while Vast.ai leads A100 80GB SXM at $1.14.
MI300X supply is thin, with only 4 providers listing it compared with 12 for H100 SXM.
watch: Whether the flat +0% readings break, especially on B200, where the $14.12 hyperscaler median sits far above the $7.99 neocloud and marketplace medians.
